lines.zh: 机械关节走动时咔咔作响
lines.en: My mechanical joints click as I walk.

lines.zh: 我把手插在袖里，步子很稳
lines.en: Hands tucked in my sleeves, my stride is steady.

lines.zh: 金属的脚踩在地上，土陷下去
lines.en: My metal foot sinks the soil.

lines.zh: 我虽是改造人，走路仍像个杀手
lines.en: Cyborg or not, I still walk like an assassin.

lines.zh: 气功炮的口子藏在袖中
lines.en: The ki cannon's mouth hides in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 一米九的身子，比人高出一头
lines.en: At 1.9 meters I stand a head above men.

lines.zh: 红缎带军团的徽记还留着
lines.en: The Red Ribbon crest is still on me.

lines.zh: 我的动作没有多余的一分
lines.en: Not one motion of mine is wasted.

lines.zh: 转弯时脊椎响了一下
lines.en: My spine clicks as I turn.

lines.zh: 风从肋间的缝里穿过去
lines.en: Wind passes through the gap in my ribs.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可每一步都量过
lines.en: I walk slowly, every step measured.

lines.zh: 手掌张开又握紧，试了试力道
lines.en: I open and close my hand, testing the grip.

lines.zh: 我站着像个铁桩
lines.en: I stand like an iron post.

lines.zh: 袖口里偶尔有电流的响
lines.en: Now and then a current hums in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我不怎么眨眼，机械不需要
lines.en: I rarely blink; machinery has no need.

lines.zh: 杀手的耐心，比命长
lines.en: An assassin's patience outlives him.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手
lines.en: I look down at my own hand.

lines.zh: 金属表面有一道旧刮痕
lines.en: There is an old scrape on the metal.

lines.zh: 我在等一个指令，或者一个破绽
lines.en: I wait for an order, or an opening.

lines.zh: 呼吸是装出来的，很均匀
lines.en: My breathing is imitation, perfectly even.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角吹得笔直
lines.en: Wind pulls my hem straight.

lines.zh: 我不乱动，乱动会露破绽
lines.en: I keep still; movement betrays openings.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听远处的声音
lines.en: I tilt an ear to sounds far off.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，看了看掌纹
lines.en: I turn my palm up and study the lines.

lines.zh: 我把头偏了一点，角度精准
lines.en: I tilt my head, precisely.

lines.zh: 我把袖口拉正，遮住炮口
lines.en: I straighten my cuff to hide the cannon.

lines.zh: 我侧过脸看你，眼神很平
lines.en: I turn to you with a level look.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在射线上
lines.en: You stand right on my firing line.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根手指，比了比距离
lines.en: I raise a finger to gauge the distance.

lines.zh: 改造过的眼睛能看清你的脉搏
lines.en: My rebuilt eyes can see your pulse.

lines.zh: 你手放在哪儿，我都知道
lines.en: I know where your hands are.

lines.zh: 我低声笑了一下，像金属摩擦
lines.en: I laugh low, like metal grating.

lines.zh: 你这么站着，是来找死吗
lines.en: Standing like that, have you come to die?

lines.zh: 我把袖子往上捋了一点
lines.en: I push my sleeve up a little.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的喉咙上
lines.en: My gaze settles on your throat.

lines.zh: 你说完没有，我要动手了
lines.en: Are you finished? I am about to move.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢废话，也不喜欢活口
lines.en: I dislike idle talk, and survivors.

lines.zh: 你比上次那些废物强一点
lines.en: You are a little better than the last trash.

lines.zh: 我把你看得很仔细,从头到脚
lines.en: I study you closely, head to toe.

lines.zh: 我只说一遍，让开
lines.en: I will say it once: stand aside.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了,我听得见
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我抬手，不是打招呼
lines.en: My raised hand is not a greeting.

lines.zh: 我在想要不要留你一条命
lines.en: I am deciding whether to let you live.

lines.zh: 机械眼把你的体温扫了一遍
lines.en: My mechanical eye sweeps your body heat once

lines.zh: 金属外壳凹进一块
lines.en: A plate of my casing dents inward.

lines.zh: 接缝处冒出一点火星
lines.en: Sparks jump from a seam.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新校准
lines.en: I step back and recalibrate.

lines.zh: 这一下打到我的机件上
lines.en: That blow landed on my machinery.

lines.zh: 我咬住牙，血是温的
lines.en: I bite down; my blood is warm.

lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，我强行掰回
lines.en: A joint sticks; I force it back.

lines.zh: 我的视线晃了一瞬
lines.en: My sight wavers for an instant.

lines.zh: 身体里有根线断了
lines.en: Something inside me has snapped.

lines.zh: 我扶住自己的手臂
lines.en: I hold my own arm.

lines.zh: 血从金属缝里渗出来
lines.en: Blood seeps out between the metal seams.

lines.zh: 那袋子里的东西，我能吃吗
lines.en: Can I eat what is in that sack?

lines.zh: 改造后胃口反而更大
lines.en: Rebuilt, my appetite only grew.

lines.zh: 我在红缎带军团吃了不少苦
lines.en: I ate plenty of grief in the Red Ribbon Army.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起以前的饭
lines.en: This smell reminds me of old meals.

lines.zh: 我伸手，机械指节轻响
lines.en: I reach out and my mechanical knuckles tick.

lines.zh: 不是饿，是习惯
lines.en: Not hunger; habit.

lines.zh: 你留着也没用，给我
lines.en: You have no use for it; give it here.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，判断有没有毒
lines.en: I sniff, judging whether it is poisoned.

lines.zh: 这种东西，我以前瞧不上
lines.en: I once turned my nose up at such things.

lines.zh: 换我年轻时，早抢了
lines.en: In my younger days I would have taken it.

lines.zh: 我的金属肩撞上你
lines.en: My metal shoulder meets you.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我像一堵墙
lines.en: You crash into me like a wall.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶住你，免得你摔倒
lines.en: I catch you before you fall.

lines.zh: 我的肘部磕到你的骨头
lines.en: My elbow clips your bone.

lines.zh: 关节发出一声闷响
lines.en: A joint gives a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，纯属礼让
lines.en: I give half a step, purely out of courtesy.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背，硬邦邦的
lines.en: You step on my foot; it is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我几乎没动
lines.en: We collide and I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我用小臂挡开你,顺手一推
lines.en: I parry with my forearm and shove.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胸口，像撞铁板
lines.en: You hit my chest like a steel slab.

lines.zh: 她也是被改造过的，我们彼此明白
lines.en: She is rebuilt too; we understand each other.

lines.zh: 我们不谈过去
lines.en: We do not speak of the past.

lines.zh: 她检查我肩上的接缝
lines.en: She checks the seam on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我替她拧紧手肘的螺栓
lines.en: I tighten the bolt at her elbow.

lines.zh: 两只铁手碰在一起，声音很轻
lines.en: Two metal hands touch, softly.

lines.zh: 她说我冷，我说我耐用
lines.en: She says I am cold; I say I am durable.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，像两件兵器
lines.en: We stand side by side like two weapons.

lines.zh: 她的眼神和我一样，没有温度
lines.en: Her eyes are as warm as mine: not at all.

lines.zh: 我们约定，谁先死，另一个收尸
lines.en: We agree: whoever falls first, the other buries him.

lines.zh: 半夜里我们都不睡
lines.en: Neither of us sleeps at night.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，腰上的机件响了一声
lines.en: I bend and a mechanism in my back clicks.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指夹起那东西
lines.en: I pinch it up with two fingers.

lines.zh: 地上的钱币，我一个不漏
lines.en: Not a single coin on the ground escapes me.

lines.zh: 我把它在掌心转了转
lines.en: I turn it over in my palm.

lines.zh: 机械手不会抖，捡得干净
lines.en: A mechanical hand does not shake; it picks clean.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚弹壳，收进袖子
lines.en: I pocket a spent casing in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 捡起来看了看，又扔了
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and toss it away.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖一挑，东西落进手里
lines.en: A flick of my toe lands it in my hand.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我全收了
lines.en: I take everything on the ground.

lines.zh: 机械手张开，正好扣住
lines.en: My mechanical hand opens and closes on it.

lines.zh: 我看定你，袖口亮了一下
lines.en: I fix on you and my sleeve glows.

lines.zh: 气功炮开始充能
lines.en: The ki cannon begins to charge.

lines.zh: 你已经是目标了
lines.en: You are the target now.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心对准你
lines.en: I raise my palm, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 这一击不会给你反应的时间
lines.en: This shot leaves you no time to react.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛缩了一下
lines.en: My eyes contract.

lines.zh: 距离十二步，正好
lines.en: Twelve paces: perfect.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到前脚
lines.en: I shift my weight to the lead foot.

lines.zh: 杀气藏在我平静的脸后面
lines.en: The killing intent hides behind my calm face.

lines.zh: 我的手腕一翻，炮口对准
lines.en: A turn of my wrist aims the cannon.

lines.zh: 我不再笑了，脸上没表情
lines.en: I stop smiling; my face goes blank.

lines.zh: 你已经没有退路了
lines.en: You have no way left to retreat.

lines.zh: 这一次，我不会打偏
lines.en: This time I will not miss.

lines.zh: 我把你算进了这一炮里
lines.en: I have factored you into this shot.

lines.zh: 我的手指停在扳机上
lines.en: My finger rests on the trigger.

lines.zh: 你背后的墙,正好接住你
lines.en: The wall behind you will catch you.

lines.zh: 我举着手，慢慢跟着你
lines.en: I keep my palm up and track you slowly.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的袖口就往左
lines.en: You go left; my sleeve follows.

lines.zh: 充能的声音越来越尖
lines.en: The charge whines higher and higher.

lines.zh: 我不急，光炮不会跑
lines.en: I am patient; the beam will not run off.

lines.zh: 你的路线很直，太好算
lines.en: Your path is straight; too easy to read.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你没退
lines.en: I step forward and you do not back away.

lines.zh: 准星一直压在你的胸口
lines.en: My aim stays on your chest.

lines.zh: 你找了掩体，可掩体不够厚
lines.en: You found cover, but it is too thin.

lines.zh: 我换了只手，角度变了
lines.en: I switch hands and change the angle.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我不会失手
lines.en: At this range I will not miss.

lines.zh: 我的手指开始收拢
lines.en: My fingers begin to curl.

lines.zh: 再等两秒我就动手
lines.en: Two more seconds and I strike.

lines.zh: 我压低炮口，瞄你的膝盖
lines.en: I lower the cannon to your knees.

lines.zh: 你每次探头，我都等一等
lines.en: Each time you peek out, I wait.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙根移动脚步
lines.en: I move along the wall's base.

lines.zh: 光在袖口积成一团
lines.en: Light gathers into a ball at my cuff.

lines.zh: 我调整了角度，只差一线
lines.en: I adjust the angle; only a hair off.

lines.zh: 你在拖时间，我知道
lines.en: You are stalling; I know it.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，踹在你的胸口
lines.en: I lift a foot into your chest.

lines.zh: 机械臂挥出，风声很硬
lines.en: My mechanical arm swings with a hard wind.

lines.zh: 我用掌缘切你的颈侧
lines.en: I knife the edge of my hand at your neck.

lines.zh: 气功激光擦着你的肩过去
lines.en: The ki laser grazes past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面陷了
lines.en: I drive a fist down and the ground caves.

lines.zh: 你的攻击打在我身上，没什么感觉
lines.en: Your blow lands and I hardly feel it.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，反拧
lines.en: I catch your wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 我一膝撞进你的腰侧
lines.en: My knee drives into your side.

lines.zh: 这一招我只用了半成
lines.en: I used half a tenth of my strength.

lines.zh: 我用肘击你的太阳穴
lines.en: I hammer my elbow at your temple.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我立刻换另一只手
lines.en: You block; I switch to the other hand at once.

lines.zh: 我撤步，袖口又亮了
lines.en: I step back and my sleeve glows again.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比我想的脆
lines.en: Your bones are more brittle than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的掌根撞到你的锁骨
lines.en: My palm heel cracks your collarbone.

lines.zh: 一脚踢空，我立刻收回
lines.en: The kick misses; I recover at once.

lines.zh: 我贴身用肩撞你
lines.en: I close in and ram you with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，脚步无声
lines.en: I step out of the shadow without a sound.

lines.zh: 袖口的指示灯亮了一下
lines.en: The indicator in my sleeve blinks once.

lines.zh: 机械的关节一节节展开
lines.en: My joints unfold one by one.

lines.zh: 我叫桃白白，记住这个名字
lines.en: I am Tao Pai Pai; remember it.

lines.zh: 红缎带的旧账，我来收
lines.en: I have come to settle Red Ribbon debts.

lines.zh: 空气里有一丝焦味
lines.en: There is a faint burnt smell in the air.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，像看一件活
lines.en: I look at you the way one looks at a job.

lines.zh: 身体里有什么开始运转
lines.en: Something inside me begins to run.

lines.zh: 我把袖子整理好
lines.en: I smooth my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我立定，脚下的草被压平
lines.en: I come to a stop and the grass flattens.

lines.zh: 我把手从袖子里抽出来
lines.en: I draw my hand from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 远处传来一声闷响
lines.en: A dull boom sounds far off.

lines.zh: 我停在阴影和光的交界
lines.en: I halt where shadow meets light.

lines.zh: 旧伤在雨前发疼
lines.en: The old wound aches before rain.

lines.zh: 我把脖子转了个角度
lines.en: I rotate my neck to an angle.

lines.zh: 这一带的风我很熟
lines.en: I know the wind in this country.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的影子
lines.en: I look down at my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我的名字，你该听说过
lines.en: You should have heard my name.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，漆面起泡
lines.en: Fire bakes my casing until the paint blisters.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，机械腿先着地
lines.en: I land from height, mechanical legs first.

lines.zh: 水从接缝钻进来，我全身发麻
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams and I go numb.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，零件散落
lines.en: The blast flips me over and parts scatter.

lines.zh: 一枚弹头卡进我的胸腔
lines.en: A round lodges in my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕开金属，直打我里面
lines.en: That force slips past the metal into what is left of me.

lines.zh: 空着的胃在叫，机械不管它
lines.en: My empty stomach complains; the machinery ignores it.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，电路全部尖叫
lines.en: Lightning hits me and every circuit screams.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我一直往下
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I keep falling.
